title: The Mint Julep
description:
Minutes to Downtown yet enjoy a private quiet neighborhood. 
The Mint Julep offers the entire house with a private deck for morning coffee & wildlife watching or late night gathering.  
Something for everyone. 
Pet members are aloud with an additional cleaning fee. Ask Mo.

The space
You will have entire first floor and deck to yourself.  3 full bedrooms and a blowup mattress if needed. 
The basement is a separate rental with one guest and a private separate entrance.

Guest access
You will have a front and back private entrance.

WITHIN A BLOCK
~Starbucks
~Panera
~Chick-fil-A
~ Various food choices

WITHIN A 10 MINUTE DRIVE
~East Nashville and the best coffee, food, and beer spots
~Opry Mills 

WITHIN A 20 MINUTE DRIVE
~ Downtown
~Honky-Tonks (Tootsies!)
~Bridgestone Arena
~Nissan Stadium
~ Ryman Auditorium
~Johnny Cash Museum 
~Country Music Hall of Fame

Other things to note
Be prepared to come enjoy Nashville as well as a cozy home away from home.
